name: Toriaezu Air Plants!
original_name: とりあえず　えあぷらんちゅ!
source:
Fan disk contains short stories on games Dearest Vampire and Fluorite ~Hotaruishi~, demo versions of both games as well as CG, deskop accessory, minigame, music tracks, staff and new works  information.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Fan Disc收录了《最爱吸血鬼》和《萤石~萤石~》的短篇故事、两款游戏的试玩版、CG、桌面配件、小游戏、音乐曲目、制作人员以及新作信息。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
